subject: Ledgermore: Console walkthrough + API enablement — coordinating split sessions
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Park <sara@ledgermore.com>, Tom Ridley <tom@ledgermore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ledgermore: Console walkthrough + API enablement — coordinating split sessions

Hi Sara / Tom —

Great to meet you on the call yesterday. As discussed, we recommend running two focused sessions next week to get your teams productive with Redwood: a 60-minute SRE/infra-focused console walkthrough (networking, keys, VPC/private deployment prep, audit logs) and a 90-minute developer API enablement (auth, SDKs, example integrations, hands-on lab). Splitting keeps the decks and hands-on pieces tailored for each audience.

Proposed windows (PST):
- SRE/Infra: Tue 2028-03-08 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Devs (API lab): Tue 2028-03-08 13:00–14:30 or Wed 2028-03-09 10:00–11:30

Please let me know:
1) Which windows work best for Sara / Tom and the SRE/dev leads.
2) If you prefer both sessions recorded and shared.
3) Any preflight access we should request (VPN, service account, sample dataset) so we can provision lab creds ahead of time.

I attached a short onboarding checklist to make the preflight ask explicit. If the 8th works, Ben and Camila will join as session co-leads. I can also send individual calendar invites once we lock times.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the team productive.

—Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Ledgermore_Onboard_Checklist_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Sara Park <sara@ledgermore.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ridley <tom@ledgermore.com>, Vince Holden <vince.holden@ledgermore.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledgermore: Console walkthrough + API enablement — coordinating split sessions

Thanks, Mateo — this looks good. The team reviewed internally and a split makes sense. Quick notes from our side:

- SRE prefer the earlier slot on Tue 03/08 (9:00–10:00 PST).
- Devs would like the API lab in the afternoon on 03/08 if possible (13:00–14:30 PST) — that keeps the core devs together.
- We will need a preflight step for our security team: they want the list of IP ranges you will use, and a short list of services that need outbound access. Can you provide that?
- We can provide service accounts; I will ask Vince to send the details.

Would prefer recordings for both sessions. Please go ahead and provision invites.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Platform, Ledgermore
Sara.Park@ledgermore.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Park <sara@ledgermore.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledgermore: Console walkthrough + API enablement — coordinating split sessions

Thanks for the quick reply, Sara — locking those windows now.

We can cover the SRE preflight items in a short note (IP ranges, required outbound endpoints, and port list). I'll attach a one-page network checklist and include the minimal egress endpoints Redwood needs for normal operation (KMS, telemetry, model fetch endpoints).

Proposed calendar invites (I will send once we confirm):
- Tue 03/08 09:00–10:00 PST — "Ledgermore: Infra & Security — Redwood Console Walkthrough" (Ben, Camila, Mateo)
- Tue 03/08 13:00–14:30 PST — "Ledgermore: Devs — API Enablement & Hands-on Lab" (Mateo, Camila, Tessa)

Before the lab we will need:
- A service account or short-lived creds (Vince / Sara to provide)
- A sample dataset (small, anonymized) or a pointer to where we can pull sample data
- Confirmation whether your devs will use their laptops (we provide a browser-based lab) or corporate machines behind an enforced proxy (if proxy, share proxy details)

Calendly quick-book link if you want to pick alternate slots: https://calendly.com/redwood/mateo-onboard-60

Attachment: redwood_onboard_runbook.odt (ODT)

Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledgermore: Console walkthrough + API enablement — coordinating split sessions

Perfect — thanks Ben, Mateo. 03/08 09:00–10:00 and 13:00–14:30 PST are locked on our side. A couple of final asks before you send invites: 

- Vince will send service account details by EOD today.
- Please send the one-page network checklist (we need to pass it to infra).
- Can you add "recording will be shared" to the invite description and include an optional link to the lab materials?
- Tom asked if the dev session can include a 15-minute Q&A at the end and whether you can record the lab output as a short artifact (not production data).

Once you send invites we will accept and add internal attendee names.

Appreciate the responsiveness — excited to get started.

Best,
Sara
Head of Platform, Ledgermore
